"""Local reviewer oracle from locked SPEC; no worker helper/import reuse."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
CUSTODY = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CLI = REPO / 'governance/compat/run_preapproval_feasibility_gate.py'
RANGE = REPO / 'governance/compat/check_preapproval_feasibility.py'
PROPOSAL = 'docs/work_orders/CVF_LOCAL_ROOT_PROBE.md'
COMPANION = 'docs/reviews/evidence/local-root-probe.json'
BASELINE = 'docs/baselines/CVF_GC018_LOCAL_ORACLE.md'
RETURN = 'docs/reviews/CVF_LOCAL_ROOT_PROBE_RETURN.md'
SCOPED = 'FEASIBLE_FOR_INTEGRATED_ROOT_BUILD'
OUTCOME = {
    'schemaVersion': 'cvf.semanticConvergenceControl.v1',
    'problemKey': 'local-independent-ncr-root-build-oracle',
    'chainMode': 'INITIAL', 'chainOrdinal': 0, 'predecessor': None,
    'blockerDelta': {k: [] for k in ('prior','resolved','retained','new','reopened','current')},
    'resolutionEvidence': {},
    'counters': {k: 0 for k in ('partialReadyClosures','reviewerScopeExpansions','sameClaimCorrections','nonDecreasingBlockerTransitions')},
    'claims': [], 'requiredDisposition': 'ROOT_CONTRACT_REQUIRED',
    'successorScope': 'INTEGRATED_ROOT_CONTRACT',
}

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def write(root, path, data):
    target = root / path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(data.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(data,str) else data)

def fixture(root, outcome=None, baseline=BASELINE, return_field=True):
    outcome = copy.deepcopy(outcome or OUTCOME)
    source = '# Local locked baseline\n\n## Build baseline\n\n## Build scope\n'
    write(root, baseline, source)
    text = '# Local independent caller fixture\n\ndocType: work_order\nStatus: DISPATCH_READY\n'
    text += 'Preapproval-Feasibility: REQUIRED\nPreapproval-Feasibility-Companion: ' + COMPANION + '\n'
    if return_field:
        text += 'workerReturnPath: `' + RETURN + '`\n'
    text += '\n## Semantic Convergence Outcome\n\n```json\n' + json.dumps(outcome,indent=2) + '\n```\n'
    write(root, PROPOSAL, text)
    proposal_sha = sha(text.encode())
    comp = {
        'schemaVersion':'cvf.preapprovalFeasibility.v1',
        'proposal':{'path':PROPOSAL,'sha256':proposal_sha},
        'approvalTarget':{'path':PROPOSAL,'sha256':proposal_sha,
            'prospectiveOutcomeSha256':sha(json.dumps(outcome,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')).encode())},
        'prospectiveOutcome':outcome,
        'phasePrerequisites':{'phase':'PRE_DISPATCH_INTEGRATED_ROOT_CONTRACT_BUILD','rows':[
            {'requirementId':rid,'requiredForPhase':True,'evidence':{'path':baseline,'sha256':sha(source.encode()),'locator':locator},'deferredToPhase':None}
            for rid,locator in [('ROOT_BUILD_BASELINE','## Build baseline'),('ROOT_BUILD_SCOPE','## Build scope')]
        ]},
        'requestQueue':None,
        'requestedAction':{'kind':'INTEGRATED_ROOT_CONTRACT_BUILD','runtimeReadinessClaim':False},
    }
    save_comp(root,comp)
    return comp

def save_comp(root, comp):
    write(root,COMPANION,json.dumps(comp,indent=2)+'\n')

def run(command, root):
    started=time.perf_counter()
    p=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',timeout=25)
    return {'command':command,'exitCode':p.returncode,'elapsedSeconds':round(time.perf_counter()-started,3),'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}

def remove_owned_fixture(root):
    root = root.resolve()
    root.relative_to(CUSTODY.resolve())
    if not root.name.startswith('local-owned-fixture-'):
        raise ValueError('not a Local owned fixture')
    def writable_retry(function, path, exc_info):
        target=Path(path).resolve()
        target.relative_to(root)
        target.chmod(stat.S_IWRITE | stat.S_IREAD)
        function(path)
    shutil.rmtree(root,onerror=writable_retry)

def observe(root,label,expected,code=None):
    result=run([sys.executable,'-B',str(CLI),'--repo-root',str(root),'--proposal',PROPOSAL,'--approval-target',PROPOSAL,'--json'],root)
    receipt=json.loads(result['stdout'])
    codes=[d['code'] for d in receipt['diagnostics']]
    passed=(result['exitCode']=={'INVALID':1,'HOLD':2,SCOPED:0}[expected]
        and receipt['technicalDisposition']==expected
        and receipt['effectAdmission'] is False and receipt['operatorApprovalRequired'] is True
        and (receipt.get('runtimeReadiness') is False if expected==SCOPED else 'runtimeReadiness' not in receipt)
        and (code is None or code in codes))
    return {'case':label,'expected':expected,'observed':receipt['technicalDisposition'],'diagnosticCodes':codes,'pass':passed,'invocation':result,'receipt':receipt}

def main():
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='local-owned-fixture-',dir=CUSTODY)).resolve()
    root.relative_to(CUSTODY.resolve())
    cases=[]
    try:
        fixture(root)
        cases.append(observe(root,'positive-initial-zero-counters',SCOPED))
        comp=fixture(root); del comp['requestedAction']; save_comp(root,comp)
        cases.append(observe(root,'phase-only-no-action','HOLD'))
        stop=copy.deepcopy(OUTCOME); stop.update(requiredDisposition='STOP_REASSESS_ARCHITECTURE',successorScope='NO_SUCCESSOR')
        fixture(root,stop)
        cases.append(observe(root,'stop-with-action','HOLD'))
        comp=fixture(root); comp['requestedAction']['runtimeReadinessClaim']=0; save_comp(root,comp)
        cases.append(observe(root,'numeric-zero-is-not-false','INVALID','ACTION_READINESS_CLAIM_INVALID'))
        comp=fixture(root); comp['requestedAction']=None; save_comp(root,comp)
        cases.append(observe(root,'explicit-null-action','INVALID','ACTION_SHAPE'))
        fixture(root); write(root,BASELINE,'# changed baseline bytes\n')
        cases.append(observe(root,'baseline-source-drift','INVALID','PREREQ_EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH'))
        fixture(root,return_field=False)
        cases.append(observe(root,'unbuildable-return-route','INVALID','WORKER_RETURN_ROUTE_UNBUILDABLE'))
        comp=fixture(root); comp['phasePrerequisites']['rows'].pop(); save_comp(root,comp)
        cases.append(observe(root,'missing-root-scope','INVALID','ROOT_BUILD_ROW_MISSING'))
        fixture(root,baseline='docs/baselines/local/CVF_GC018_LOCAL_ORACLE.md')
        cases.append(observe(root,'nested-baseline-within-spec-family',SCOPED))
        fixture(root)
        for args in [['init','-q'],['config','user.name','Local disposable probe'],['config','user.email','local-probe@example.invalid'],['config','core.autocrlf','false']]:
            subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=root,check=True,capture_output=True)
        write(root,'fixture-anchor.txt','Local disposable anchor\n')
        subprocess.run(['git','add','fixture-anchor.txt'],cwd=root,check=True,capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.hooksPath=NUL','commit','-qm','Local disposable anchor'],cwd=root,check=True,capture_output=True)
        result=run([sys.executable,'-B',str(RANGE),'--repo-root',str(root),'--base','HEAD','--head','HEAD','--enforce','--json'],root)
        report=json.loads(result['stdout'])
        passed=(result['exitCode']==0 and report['counts']=={'FEASIBLE':0,SCOPED:1,'HOLD':0,'INVALID':0} and report['coverage']['evaluatedMarked']==1)
        cases.append({'case':'actual-range-separate-scoped-bucket','pass':passed,'invocation':result,'report':report})
    finally:
        write(CUSTODY,'probe-before-cleanup.json',json.dumps(cases,indent=2)+'\n')
        remove_owned_fixture(root)
    payload={'actor':'LOCAL_REVIEWER_NOT_IMPLEMENTATION_WORKER','startedUtc':started,
        'finishedUtc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'oracleSeparationBasis':'Locally authored declarative fixtures and SPEC assertions; subprocess-only caller/range execution; no worker test helper or evaluator import.',
        'probeOracleSha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),'passed':sum(c['pass'] for c in cases),'total':len(cases),
        'cases':cases,'temporaryFixtureCleanup':{'path':str(root),'removed':not root.exists()},'providerCalls':0}
    write(CUSTODY,'probe-results.json',json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'passed':payload['passed'],'total':payload['total'],'cases':[{k:c[k] for k in ('case','pass')} for c in cases],'fixtureRemoved':not root.exists()},indent=2))
    return 0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1

if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
